Local parameter at a winding point / at infinity
Cutting lines $l_\nu$ from the singular points, with jump $2\pi i a_\nu$ across them to make the logarithmic part single-valued

methods.what: Dirichlet's principle: a function on the cut surface with prescribed singularities can be turned into an analytic function of $x+yi$ by adding a continuous function with constant jumps across the cross-cuts, unique up to an additive constant

items.english: By Dirichlet's principle, $\alpha+\beta i$ can be turned into a function of $x+yi$ (continuous in $T'$) by adding a function of $x,y$ that is everywhere continuous in $T'$ and is greater by a constant on one side of each cross-cut than on the other; it is determined up to an additive constant.
